detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: To detect and block malicious or vulnerable components, implement a repository firewall that uses AI-driven behavioral analysis, automated quarantine, and policy enforcement. Monitor for abnormal component behaviors, such as unexpected network activity, suspicious code patterns, or metadata anomalies. Quarantine and review any component flagged as suspicious before allowing it into the development pipeline. Integrate with your artifact repository (e.g., Nexus, Artifactory) to ensure only vetted components are available to developers.
